svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Version 0.1 at a glance
svg.desc: Version 0.1 at a glance. From the question to one count: each number, and the set it was taken from. The question: what does a missense variant, one that changes a single amino acid, do to RyR1's structure and function? The structures: 188 entries in the Protein Data Bank holding RyR1 (found by the project's searches on 3 and 6 October 2026 (IST)); then 155 electron-microscopy entries (whose deposited RyR1 sequence has 3,000 residues or more); then 26 structures measured; the other 129 were not (24 named before any was measured (6 October 2026), and a pair added later under the same criteria (9ZO8, 9ZOE)); then 104 chains: 13 rabbit, 6 mouse and 7 pig structures (four chains each). Beside them: Their numbering: 20 checked two ways (against SIFTS and by the project's alignment): 13 rabbit, 6 mouse and pig 9PWO; 6 pig by the alignment alone; in 5, one stretch numbered one off; Their state at the gate: 14 closed, 12 open, none between the class lines, which were committed before the first measurement. The residues: 5,038 human residues (UniProt P21817) (each mapped to its partner, or to none, in rabbit, mouse and pig); then 299 residues, fixed in advance (where at least one of ClinVar's expert-panel records describes a single missense change). Beside them: 358 expert-panel records: of 379 read, 21 excluded; ClinVar classes 222 as of uncertain significance, 97 as pathogenic or likely pathogenic, 34 as benign or likely benign, 5 other; 624 missense variants: in gnomAD, at 260 of the 299 residues. Where they meet: 31,096 rows: each of the 299 residues in each of the 104 chains: 27,228 joined; 2,344 the chain models no residue at the partner's place; 1,496 the numbering cannot decide; 24 not joined: a difference not declared, or a stretch of low identity; 4 withdrawn by the test by coordinates. One count: Of the 222 records of uncertain significance, at 200 residues, 213 are joined in at least one closed structure and 212 in at least one open one, on numbering that both of the numbering check's paths agree on; the 212 are all among the 213, so they can be read on structures of both classes; 9 are joined in none. These are counts of where the records can be read: nothing about any variant is inferred from them. The 26 structures are a chosen set, not RyR1's structures in general; the 299 residues are where at least one expert-panel record describes a single missense change, not every residue that matters.
